answer: The strongest proof is the one made before the test existed. Mortgage repayment history with lender attestation is exactly that: repayments logged monthly for years by the mortgage lender. The quartz of the proof is its age — created for taxes, work, or licensing years ago, when nobody was watching. Forging it now means backdating a history in front of clerks who keep their own copies, and the reef of the forgery is the conspiracy: a hundred clerks, a hundred books, a hundred lies that must all agree. The willow that finishes the check is the clerk's own copy, produced on request.
